distribution.summary: 福建；广西；西藏；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) adds Fujian and Guangxi; Xizang, Yunnan and Taiwan are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports China (WP) and Taiwan. The broad China (WP) wording is retained as source-level context and is not expanded into mainland provinces.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) directly reports Quercus × leana; baseline hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) states that the species is polyphagous but reports no Taiwan host taxon, so no host is added.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus brevis (Eichhoff, 1877).
